name: Anastrozole
description: A reversible non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor approved for hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer. It blocks peripheral conversion of androgens to estrogens. Use to control estradiol during androgen therapy is off-label.

systems.note: Inhibition of aromatase, lowering circulating estradiol; the intended pharmacology.
Estrogen deprivation reduces bone mineral density; labelled.
Adverse lipid movement under estrogen deprivation is labelled.

monitors.why: The direct index of the effect the drug is given for; over-suppression is the characteristic failure mode.
Labelled bone density loss under estrogen deprivation.
